trust.schemaDescription: Our trust pillars, third-party subprocessors, certifications, and how to report a security incident.
trust.title: Where to find the proof.
trust.lede: Every claim we make about security, privacy, sustainability, and access links to the evidence. You should never have to take our word for it.
trust.certsEmpty: None yet. When we are certified, it will show up here with a link to the evidence.
trust.certsEmptyBody: We are a small studio. Formal certifications are expensive and slow. When we earn one it will appear here with a link to the issuer.
trust.subprocessorsLede: Every third party that may touch your data, what they access, and where they operate.
trust.incidentHeading: Found something? Please tell us first.
trust.incidentBody: Coordinated disclosure is the path we take seriously. Email security@intelligentsingularityai.com with a description and reproduction steps. We acknowledge reports within one business day, triage within three, and ship a fix on a timeline we agree with you. Researchers are credited by name in our post-mortem when a fix ships — unless you prefer to remain anonymous. We do not threaten or sue good-faith security researchers, full stop.
trust.metaDescription: Pillars of trust, third-party subprocessors, certifications, and how to report an incident.

manifesto.offlinePercentHeading: Two-point-two billion people are still offline today.
manifesto.offlinePercentBody: The lighter dots above are the people already online. The darker, ringed dots are the people who are not. Ninety-six percent of the offline population lives in low- and middle-income countries. Universal-access engineering is what closes that gap. The nine commitments below are how we hold ourselves to it.
manifesto.commitmentsBody: Nine concentric rings — every product ships against every one of them, every release. The list is not a wishlist. It is the engineering contract.
manifesto.schemaDescription: Read our manifesto on making enterprise-grade software a basic right for every business and person, online or offline.

careers.whatYouWouldWorkOnLede: Intelligent Singularity is the parent company of a growing family of platforms. New hires rarely work on a single product for an entire year — most cycle across two or three, depending on what is shipping and what needs the most senior attention that quarter.
careers.howWeHireLede: Four steps. Maximum two weeks from first email to written offer if both sides move quickly. No surprise stages, no unpaid take-homes, no "culture fit" rejections without a written reason.

green.schemaDescription: See our environmental commitments, page-weight transparency, and low-emission web performance approach.
green.statThirdPartyHint: No pixels · no fonts · no CDN on this site
green.byteBudgetHeading: How the byte budget stays small
green.pledgeHeading: We publish everything. You hold us accountable.
green.pledgeBody: Every number on this page is computed live from real measurements. The bundle budget is enforced by CI; the third-party count is audited on every build; the carbon estimate uses Green Web Foundation methodology against the page weight you actually loaded. If something looks wrong, tell us — we will respond in writing within five business days, with the underlying numbers shown.

bundleBudget.label: Bundle budget
bundleBudget.hint: Gzipped. Enforced by CI on every pull request — a build that breaks the budget cannot ship.

thirdPartyCalls.label: Third-party calls
thirdPartyCalls.hint: No analytics, fonts, pixels, video embeds, social widgets, or CDN round-trips on this site. Audited per build by no-third-party.mjs.

renderer.label: Renderer
renderer.hint: Pages render on the server and stream to the browser. Hydration is opt-in, per-component, never global.

mediaStrategy.label: Media strategy
mediaStrategy.hint: No raster heroes. Inline SVG illustrations. Per-script font subsets loaded only when that script is on the page.

offlineReach.label: Offline reach
offlineReach.hint: Network-first HTML · stale-while-revalidate assets · offline fallback page on every locale.

reducedMotion.label: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.hint: Every animation pauses when prefers-reduced-motion is set. No exceptions, no opt-outs needed.

paperless.label: Paperless by default
paperless.hint: Invoices, medical records, receipts default to digital. Office paper, business cards, and printed marketing collateral are not part of how we operate.
